edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build

  Scenario: AC6 Rules BR1 to BR9 hold on the take-on path
    Given the take-on path has run for case "RC-2026-000511"
    When the boundary and contract checks run
    Then only the asset row is written to rwb_asset, no cross-schema join or foreign key exists, no person name, address, contact value or identity number is stored, and one AssetTakenOn is published per confirmed take-on

  Scenario: AC7 Error answers of the provided operations
    Given a caller without a credential, a role without the Asset and disposal right, and an asset reference that does not exist
    When GET /assets and GET /assets/{assetId} are called
    Then the caller without a credential gets 401, the role without the right gets 403 and the unknown asset reference gets 404, and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC8 Activity retry and timeout
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock does not answer inside 2 s
    When the take-on activity runs
    Then the step retries on the workflow's own schedule, writes nothing and returns no outcome

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call fails
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock returns an error for the ACE asset fact
    When its trigger arrives
    Then nothing is written, no outcome is returned and the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the case state "ASSET_HELD" for "RC-2026-000511"
    When its trigger arrives
    Then nothing changes and the step returns without a move
